title: Kiritani Haruka — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Excuse me... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Azusawa, hello.
Thank you for coming to get me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you since I was the one who asked first...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But is there something you wanted to talk to me about?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. There's actually someone I'd like you to meet. Would you mind following me to the school gate?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Someone you'd like me to meet?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Main Gate

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An! So this is who you were talking about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! I mean, it is your birthday today, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Hehe. Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The last time must have been... Elementary school?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. You ended up going to Miya Girls for junior high and were way too busy while you were in ASRUN, so we haven't had a chance since then, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, we really haven't...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we're gonna celebrate like normal from now on as best friends! Of course, presents included!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Since you're willing to go that far, I'll be expecting something good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Promise not to be too surprised?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here you go! A special pass for Weekend Garage! I know the great Haruka Kiritani's always super busy, so stop by if you ever want some time to relax♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, thank you! Incidentally, the others in my group have been asking me to take proper breaks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I get what they mean. You pretty much always maintain your idol persona so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even though I don't actually mean to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. You'll see Kohane and me there too, so just think of it as going over to a friend's house!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right, thanks. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, also, Azusawa said that she didn't want to intrude and is waiting by the entrance right now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
She didn't have to...
But I'll be sure to thank her later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! That girl in your group, Minori! She's really good friends with Kohane, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They seem to be. Minori mentioned before that she's the first friend she ever made in high school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, apparently, they've even gone to PXL together already.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! I couldn't believe it when I heard that! I mean, it's so unfair! Kohane's my partner...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, I owe Minori a lot too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it's so interesting how our friends ended up becoming friends with each other.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really is. We should all do something together sometime.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
But hands off Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, whoa! Time to go!
I'm gonna be late for practice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to talk more, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We talked plenty! And thanks for being so thoughtful, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I need to thank you as well, Azusawa. I really appreciate what you did for us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! But I didn't do anything...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's not true.
It's been so long since An and I were able to talk like this, so thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And thank you for visiting me at school like this, An. It was really fun talking to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll see you later!
Don't forget to stop by my place when you can!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right, I promise to go!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that must be her!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does this mean you're all here to watch our fan meeting?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right♪
We're here to celebrate with you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
We have some fun ideas planned, so I hope you enjoy them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?!
I can't wait to see what you have in store for us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're so professional. Despite being today's star, you're still prioritizing how much the audience enjoys things.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because she's an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, everyone! Hi, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, Minori.
Did you finish what you needed to do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? You had something to do, Minori? And what's with all these bags...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Th-This was absolutely necessary...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Anyway, try not to mind these!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Minori, the design on those bags...
They look like...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nooo! She'll see her present...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Those bags are from that Penguin Cafe we all went to the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. I probably shouldn't say anything for now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure Airi and the others are busy preparing, Minori, so I'll help out too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “We will now be presenting the wonderful birthday greetings that Haruka has received! Take it away!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Kiritani, thank you for letting me and my friends talk to you about our band. You've been a great role model in terms of us becoming professional musicians.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Haruka! Did you hear about the new stuff they put on the menu at the Penguin Cafe?! We should definitely go check it out together sometime♪”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Thank you for always keeping an eye on my sister. I'd also like it if we could chat more about Phenny sometime...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Haruka, it was so much fun being on the Sports Festival committee with you☆ I hope we get to work together on it again and make everything even more fun♪”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “I can tell by the way Minori talks about you that you're really a wonderful person, and I'm so happy that we've become friends. I hope we'll have more chances to talk.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Your special pass won't ever expire, but make sure to stop by, alright? I'll be waiting! Also, there's a little stage inside so we should sing together sometime!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Haruka, you've been so reliable and such a huge help! Along with Minori and Shizuku, let's make MORE MORE JUMP! really something special!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “Haruka, we weren't able to visit that cafe with the low-sugar desserts, but I promise to find it again and I hope you'll join me when I do!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Happy haaappy birthday, Haruka! You being brought into this world was the greatest thing that's ever happened to me!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “So is standing alongside you as an idol! I still can't believe it and I'm still really new to this, but I'm really looking forward to doing more with you!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for joining me in celebrating my birthday today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't express how happy I am to return to the stage as an idol and sing for all of my fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I want to spread as much hope as I can, as Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Promise to cheer us on?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll do everything I can... No, if I say that, I'll make Shizuku and the others worry about me again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I promise to do my best while taking proper breaks from time to time and make this year count.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we'll be looking forward to all of your support moving forward!
